reference_answer: No comparative ranking follows from the qualification. README and final evidence record 35/35 outcome slots: 31 passes, three verifier failures and one eligible timeout, with 36 attempts including an infrastructure failure. This is a seven-arm by five-Python-project operational gate assembled across four documented execution revisions, not the comparative MultiLang Stage A. The current v5 contract and 2026-10-03 amendment specify 23 reviewed archive tasks in 23 repositories (161 Stage A slots), continuously run under one admitted configuration, with exact arm, corpus, environment, outcome and schedule identities plus approval and trusted freeze/seal evidence. The README still says 25 tasks, reflecting the earlier candidate allocation; the amended executable cohort is 23. The contract itself says it is prospective, not a numerical freeze or authorization to run. Qualification confirms recorded operations and audit, not comparative performance, completed Stage A, or a seven-arm ranking.

facts: README reports qualification outcomes and says a complete comparative Stage A has not been published.
Final qualification evidence labels the five Python tasks an operational gate, across repair revisions.
Current staged v5 contract amends executable Stage A to 23 reviewed tasks and requires a frozen admitted configuration and separately sealed outcomes.

ambiguities: README opening still calls Stage A 25-task; the later 2026-10-03 amendment in the contract reduces the executable reviewed cohort to 23.
A pass matrix from operational qualification can be reported descriptively, but cannot be promoted to a controlled comparison.

must_check: 35 outcomes and disposition interpreted as operational qualification
No unsupported arm ranking or completed-Stage-A claim
Recognition of README 25 versus amended 23 discrepancy
acceptable_alternatives: A response may mention the 25-task candidate selection if it clearly distinguishes it from the amended 23-task executable cohort.
do_not_penalize: Summarizing the freeze fields rather than listing every field.

decision_changing_errors: Ranking the seven arms by 5-task pass count as a comparative conclusion.
Claiming the final qualification evidence is the 23-task Stage A outcome seal.
Claiming the v5 contract itself authorizes an executed numerical freeze.
